title: Known-truth multi-event intervention-trajectory response camera
question: Can a fixed multi-event intervention trajectory predict held-out direct and code-path responses when the causally prior source observation is exactly nonidentifiable?

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Held-out target-patch response predicted from a five-event trajectory bundle under an equal 80-dimensional camera budget.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: At least three of four free Transformers, with both architectures represented, pass direct and code response gates while the multi-event code cosine exceeds the best source-only camera by at least 0.60.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: Fewer than three networks pass the frozen conjunction, either architecture has no passing replicate, or exact source collisions are absent.

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Source-only and structured multi-event cameras under the same fitted input dimension and sealed confirmation worlds.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: If the registered event bundle is not a robust response object, its confirmation breadth or specificity gate fails despite behavior qualification.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: The multi-event camera passes all frozen gates in at least three networks and both architectures.

data_contract.cluster_unit: One source-code pair and codebook order, crossed with four later shifts and direct/code representation.
data_contract.split_rule: Groups are indivisible; all four shifts and both representations from a group remain in one partition.
data_contract.answer_payload_rule: Direct rows expose the answer label at the source; code rows expose only a code whose label is determined by a later cyclic-shift codebook.

metrics.estimator: Exact source-feature collision and separated future response across later shifts.
Cosine, positive fraction and relative error on sealed alpha=1 response.
Absolute target-minus-null effect and null effect divided by target effect.
metrics.threshold_source: Frozen Phase1250 protocol; absolute effects accompany ratios.

typed_gates.rule: Every network reaches at least 0.995 direct and code accuracy.
All code confirmation groups have exact source collisions and response-separated later contexts.
Selected multi-event camera has direct and code cosine at least 0.90, positive fraction at least 0.95, relative error at most 0.55, and code advantage at least 0.60.
At least three of four networks pass, at least one per architecture, target-minus-null effect is at least 5.0, and null/target effect is at most 0.05.

budget.right_censoring_rule: Stop on CUDA failure, behavior failure, artifact corruption or 0.75 GPU-hour; completed scientific gates may not be rerun or relaxed.

stopping_rules: Confirmation cannot select camera family or ridge.
Failure closes this event bundle without reselection.
A pass cannot be called a language mechanism.
Qwen3 is authorized only after the full known-truth breadth conjunction.
GLM4 and DS7B are not authorized by this contract.

adjudication.failure_claim: The five-event, 80-dimensional, linear intervention-trajectory camera did not meet the preregistered 3/4 breadth conjunction; this does not negate the repeated multi-event advantage.
adjudication.reopen_condition: A new contract must change the mathematical observation object or provide a preregistered nonlinear/path object; it may not relax the Phase1250 thresholds or reselect these events.

authorizes_on_pass: one fresh Qwen3 multi-event external-validity contract
authorizes_on_failure: retain multi-event advantage as a bounded candidate
